text:
elaine: Morning all — quick run before today's KPI review. Noticed the webinar registration funnel looks healthy but MQLs from the same cohort are down 18% vs last week. Any quick theories?

sam: saw that too, Elaine. Landing page CTR up but form completions down. Possibly a change in the post-click copy? :thinking:

eleine: @sam nice catch — typo in the hero? I updated the A/B flags yesterday though.

marta: pulled the GA vs CRM join. Looks like GA4 recorded 1.2k signups, CRM only 980 contacts. There's a spike in `utm_campaign` tag variants (no utm vs utm=webinar-v2)

diego: could be lead routing rules stripping some leads before they hit the CRM. I'll check the webhook logs.

noah: FYI I pushed a quick dashboard patch that surfaced `source` vs `campaign` mismatch. Try this SQL snippet in BigQuery:

`````
SELECT campaign, COUNT(*) as ga_signups
FROM `redwood-marketing.ga4.events_*`
WHERE event_name='signup' AND event_date BETWEEN '2024-10-01' AND '2024-10-07'
GROUP BY campaign
ORDER BY ga_signups DESC
`````

sam: ran it — there's a long tail of `campaign=(not set)` for the webinar traffic. That'll mess up attribution windows and pipeline dashboards. :face_with_monocle:

elaine: @diego any logs on the lead intake lambda? Could a new validation rule be dropping emails with `+` signs?

diego: checking now. Found ~140 webhook rejects with `email_format` error from yesterday's 09:15–09:45 deploy. Looks like the validator got stricter.

marta: so TLDR: landing CTR ok, GA shows signups, webhook rejects are losing entries -> CRM deficit -> dashboard MQL drop. We should: roll back validator patch, reconcile missed leads, and update dashboard to show webhook accept rate.

sam: Agreed. Small ask for the KPI review: add a card showing 'webhook accept rate' and 'GA -> CRM match rate' so we can call out systemic vs creative issues. Also flag any campaign tagging gaps.

noah: I'll add two cards and a note in the weekly KPI doc. Also adding a filter with `lookback=30d` vs `lookback=7d` so we don't overreact to a single-day spike.

ga4-bot: [Automated] New GA4 export schema v3 applied to dataset `ga4.events_*` — manifest change logged.

elaine: Perfect — @diego can you rollback? @marta can you reconcile the ~140 rejects into an ingest CSV so sales ops can re-import?

diego: rolling back in 5. ETA 10m.

marta: will output CSV and drop into /marketing/ops/reconciles/ in 20m.

sam: thanks. For the KPI review I'll call out the attribution risk and recommend we add campaign validation tests in our release checklist. :white_check_mark:

elaine: Good plan. See you at the review in 20.
